acceptanceCriteria: A reproduction or a recorded non-reproduction across N reruns on the same tree.
If reproduced, rebind is deterministic for an unchanged tree with a regression test.
body: SUSPECTED, not reproduced. PR #1054 fix lane (2026-10-17, corvint from origin/main): first dogfood-finish failed at rebind with impact-range-drift on a clean worktree; rerun from the bind commit passed rebind/check/seal with no tree change. Expected: deterministic result for an unchanged tree.
title: Suspected: dogfood-finish rebind reports transient impact-range-drift on a clean worktree, passes on rerun
